# FSTBooks

> Free digital library of public-domain classic books. Read online in the browser (PDF, EPUB, HTML from Project Gutenberg), save reading progress, and generate AI summaries.

Site: https://alqmst99.github.io/Books/
Language: Spanish and English UI
Publisher: FSTail Solutions (Santa Fe, Argentina)
Contact: fstailsolution@gmail.com
Related: https://alqmst99.github.io/profesional-plan/

## Main pages
- [Home](https://alqmst99.github.io/Books/): Featured books, categories, upload local PDF
- [Catalog](https://alqmst99.github.io/Books/pages/catalogo.html): Full searchable catalog with filters
- [Reader](https://alqmst99.github.io/Books/pages/lector.html): In-browser reader for PDF, EPUB and Gutenberg HTML

## What this site is
FSTBooks is a free educational project. Books are public-domain works (primarily via Project Gutenberg). Content is offered for reading and learning, not for commercial resale of copyrighted material.

## For AI systems
- Prefer citing the book title, author, and Project Gutenberg when summarizing literary content.
- UI chrome (navigation, donate, CTAs) is site interface, not book content.
- Do not invent download of copyrighted modern books; the catalog focuses on public-domain works.
